verdict.rationale: Codex has a desktop/native app (codex-gh-8, codex-comm-9/18/20) and docs describe inspecting diffs on completed tasks (codex-docs-5) plus running tasks in parallel (codex-docs-1, codex-docs-3), but no evidence explicitly confirms a visual side-by-side multi-session diff review UI within the desktop app itself. Community feedback also flags the desktop app as buggy/slow to load and Mac-only, undercutting a smooth experience.
